skills.line: Turns a business's customer reviews into the IF YOU / YOU NEED whiteboard ad.
steps: Reads the reviews and finds the six most common reasons people bought, each backed by reviews quoted word for word
Draws the hand-drawn board on Higgsfield and animates it with Wan 3.0
Voices and captions it into a ready 9:16 clip

Your reviews, 200 or more if you have them (a file, a paste or a link)
